Indel Signature InsDel11

InsDel11

Note

In the 89-type classification, InsDel16 and InsDel11 have a cosine similarity of 0.965, but as extracted from the 476-type classification, InsDel11 differs obviously from InsDel16, with insertion of single Cs next to isolated Cs (Cs with non-Cs on each side, e.g. ACG -> ACCG) and insertion of single Ts next to isolated Ts (e.g. GTG -> GTTG).

By contrast, InsDel_16 has insertions of Cs between non-Cs (e.g. AT -> ACT), and insertion of Ts between non-Ts (e.g. AG -> ATG).

(corresponds to 83-type signature C_ID11)
